Everything builds and passes. Final verification summary:

- `internal/shell/shell.go`: added an early length guard in `Run` — `if len(command) == 0 { log.Warn("no command to run, skipping"); return nil }` — matching the file's existing `github.com/caarlos0/log` convention (lowercase message, warning used elsewhere in the project).
- `internal/shell/shell_test.go`: added an `empty command` subtest in the existing `TestRunCommand` table-style structure using `testctx.New()` and `require.NoError`.
